 * generation and verification using BoringSSL.

variables.name: key
variables.comment: * The current OpenSSL key we're operating on.

variables.name: inputBuffer
variables.comment: * Buffer to hold value to be signed or verified.

variables.name: inputIsTooLong
variables.comment: * Provides a flag to specify when the input is too long.
